results.fact: Whether the standard line is a Class 3 scramble or requires 5th-class roped climbing
results.correct_value: Class 4 (roped, loose Class 4 with a few low-5th moves; two-rope rappel descent) - not Class 3
results.evidence: The 2001 South Route report on cascadeclimber.com notes the guidebook grades the line without fifth-class climbing, yet the party roped up from the Key Ledge on and made six double-rope rappels. The companion report (mtnphil) says the guidebook grade rose from class 4 to class 4+ and describes 'mid-4th' loose rock plus a few exposed 5th-class slab moves. SummitPost says every summit of the massif requires technical climbing. So 'Class 3' and 'optional handline' are wrong; roped Class 4 with low-5th moves is right.

results.fact: total gain/loss: gain_ft vs itinerary vs approach prose
results.evidence: The 2025 report gives road's end 3,480 ft to summit 5,618 ft and 4.8 mi round trip, i.e. 2,138 ft NET, but no cumulative gain; it also describes dropping from the 4,300 ft basin to ~4,000 ft before climbing again. The 2002 report likewise drops ~150 ft toward Grotto Lake and goes 'up and down' along the ridge. So 2,138 is a floor rather than the car-to-car total, and neither source states the total; 3,400 and especially '3,900 ft one-way' are unsupported, but the true figure cannot be set from these sources.

results.fact: Itinerary summits 'via north ridge col' on the 'bouldered east summit', while waypoints/approach reach the main summit via the notch west of the tower
results.evidence: The 2025 party, finding the east ridge impassable, went from the north ridge at 5,400 ft up the bouldered EAST summit; the 2002 party took a gully to the col between the summit block and an eastern knob, then Class 4 up a knife-edge to the main summit. The itinerary schedule/note ('Summit via north ridge col', 'bouldered east summit') appears to merge the east-summit side trip with the main-summit line, while the waypoints and approach describe a notch west of a tower and a downclimb. Which line the row should present needs a clearer source.
